messages:
customer-jordan: Hey team — our Dedicated pool (dc-nyc-gpu-pool ID: pool-87) started returning 429/503s around 08:12 UTC. A bunch of requests are queued and latency spikes to >10s. Seen by multiple customers. Request examples: req=abc123 req=def456. Model: redwood-7b-instruct-v1.

maya-support: Sorry, that sounds bad. Are these errors for Hosted or Dedicated? Any recent config changes (min/max replicas, autoscaler flags)? Can you paste a short repro?

sam-cs: Customer says no config changes on their side. They reported steady QPS ~150 and sudden surge to ~400 at 08:11.

customer-jordan: This is Dedicated. Their app only throttles on our endpoint. MinReplicas=2 MaxReplicas=20, autoscaler.cooldown=60s per policy. No recent deployment.

anautomation (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: autoscaler/patch applied to pool-87 by ops at 2025-11-03T07:50:12Z

anautomation (deploy-bot): infra-bot: no rolling deploys since 2025-11-03

maya-support: Can you run a quick curl to reproduce from within the customer's VPC (or give sample payload)? Also throw the autoscaler metrics and provisioner logs here (timestamps 08:10–08:18 UTC).

customer-jordan: Repro curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-instruct-v1","input":"short prompt"}'
```
We captured a few provisioner logs:
```
[08:11:12] scaler: observed pending_pods=18 desired_replicas=3 current_replicas=2
[08:11:12] scaler: holdoff=true reason="recent_scale_event" holdoff_remaining=45s
[08:11:14] cloudapi: create_instance pool=pool-87 type=gpu.large status=429 body="Rate limit: quotaExceeded"
[08:12:05] provisioner: instance_init_time=130s id=i-0f12345
[08:12:20] scaler: re-eval pending_pods=6 desired_replicas=5 current_replicas=3
```
